}

LANG_EXTENSIONS = {
    "c": [".c", ".h"],
    "csharp": [".cs"],
    "go": [".go"],
    "hcl": [".tf", ".tfvars", ".hcl"],
    "python": [".py"],
    "rust": [".rs"],
    "typescript": [".ts", ".tsx", ".mts", ".cts"]
}

def translate_replacement(repl):
    if r'\$' in repl:
        raise ValueError("Contains invalid escape sequences: '\\$'")
    
    repl = repl.replace("$$", "\x00DOLLAR\x00")
    repl = re.sub(r'\$\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}', r'\\g<\1>', repl)
    repl = re.sub(r'\$([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)', r'\\g<\1>', repl)
    repl = repl.replace("\x00DOLLAR\x00", "$")
    return repl

def parse_args():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    
    if "--help" in args or "-h" in args:
        print(HELP_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)
        
    if "--version" in args or "-V" in args:
        print("srgn 0.14.1")
        sys.exit(0)

    for i, a in enumerate(args):
        if a == "--completions":
            if i + 1 < len(args):
                print_completions(args[i+1])
            else:
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--completions <SHELL>' but none was supplied\n")
                sys.exit(2)
        elif a.startswith("--completions="):
            print_completions(a.split("=", 1)[1])

    opts = {
        "upper": bool(os.environ.get("UPPER")),
        "lower": bool(os.environ.get("LOWER")),
        "titlecase": bool(os.environ.get("TITLECASE")),
        "normalize": bool(os.environ.get("NORMALIZE")),
        "german": bool(os.environ.get("GERMAN")),
        "symbols": bool(os.environ.get("SYMBOLS")),
        "delete": False,
        "squeeze": bool(os.environ.get("SQUEEZE")),
        "replacement": os.environ.get("REPLACE"),
        "glob": None,
        "fail_no_files": False,
        "dry_run": False,
        "invert": bool(os.environ.get("INVERT")),
        "literal_string": bool(os.environ.get("LITERAL_STRING")),
        "fail_any": False,
        "fail_none": False,
        "join_language_scopes": False,
        "line_numbers": False,
        "only_matching": False,
        "hidden": False,
        "gitignored": False,
        "sorted": False,
        "stdin_detection": "auto",
        "stdout_detection": "auto",
        "threads": None,
        "verbose": 0,
        "german_prefer_original": bool(os.environ.get("GERMAN_PREFER_ORIGINAL")),
        "german_naive": bool(os.environ.get("GERMAN_NAIVE")),
        "language_scopes": [],
        "scope": None
    }

    if "--" in args:
        dash_dash_idx = args.index("--")
        repl_args = args[dash_dash_idx + 1:]
        args = args[:dash_dash_idx]
        if repl_args:
            opts["replacement"] = repl_args[0]

    i = 0
    positionals = []
    while i < len(args):
        a = args[i]
        if a in ("-u", "--upper"):
            opts["upper"] = True
        elif a in ("-l", "--lower"):
            opts["lower"] = True
        elif a in ("-t", "--titlecase"):
            opts["titlecase"] = True
        elif a in ("-n", "--normalize"):
            opts["normalize"] = True
        elif a in ("-g", "--german"):
            opts["german"] = True
        elif a in ("-S", "--symbols"):
            opts["symbols"] = True
        elif a in ("-d", "--delete"):
            opts["delete"] = True
        elif a in ("-s", "--squeeze", "--squeeze-repeats"):
            opts["squeeze"] = True
        elif a in ("-G", "--glob"):
            if i + 1 < len(args):
                opts["glob"] = args[i+1]
                i += 1
            else:
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--glob <GLOB>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
        elif a.startswith("--glob="):
            opts["glob"] = a.split("=", 1)[1]
        elif a == "--fail-no-files":
            opts["fail_no_files"] = True
        elif a == "--dry-run":
            opts["dry_run"] = True
        elif a in ("-i", "--invert"):
            opts["invert"] = True
        elif a in ("-L", "--literal-string"):
            opts["literal_string"] = True
        elif a == "--fail-any":
            opts["fail_any"] = True
        elif a == "--fail-none":
            opts["fail_none"] = True
        elif a in ("-j", "--join-language-scopes"):
            opts["join_language_scopes"] = True
        elif a == "--line-numbers":
            opts["line_numbers"] = True
        elif a == "--only-matching":
            opts["only_matching"] = True
        elif a in ("-H", "--hidden"):
            opts["hidden"] = True
        elif a == "--gitignored":
            opts["gitignored"] = True
        elif a == "--sorted":
            opts["sorted"] = True
        elif a == "--german-prefer-original":
            opts["german_prefer_original"] = True
        elif a == "--german-naive":
            opts["german_naive"] = True
        elif a.startswith("-v"):
            opts["verbose"] += a.count("v")
        elif a in ("--c", "--cs", "--csharp", "--go", "--hcl", "--py", "--python", "--rs", "--rust", "--ts", "--typescript"):
            lang_map = {"--cs": "csharp", "--py": "python", "--rs": "rust", "--ts": "typescript"}
            lang = lang_map.get(a, a.lstrip("-"))
            if i + 1 < len(args):
                opts["language_scopes"].append((lang, args[i+1]))
                i += 1
            else:
                sys.stderr.write(f"error: a value is required for '{a}' but none was supplied\n")
                sys.exit(2)
        elif a in ("--stdin-detection", "--stdout-detection", "--threads"):
            if i + 1 < len(args):
                opts[a.lstrip("-").replace("-", "_")] = args[i+1]
                i += 1
        elif a.startswith("-") and not a.startswith("--"):
            for char in a[1:]:
                if char == "u": opts["upper"] = True
                elif char == "l": opts["lower"] = True
                elif char == "t": opts["titlecase"] = True
                elif char == "n": opts["normalize"] = True
                elif char == "g": opts["german"] = True
                elif char == "S": opts["symbols"] = True
                elif char == "d": opts["delete"] = True
                elif char == "s": opts["squeeze"] = True
                elif char == "i": opts["invert"] = True
                elif char == "L": opts["literal_string"] = True
                elif char == "j": opts["join_language_scopes"] = True
                elif char == "H": opts["hidden"] = True
                elif char == "v": opts["verbose"] += 1
                else:
                    sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '-{char}' found\n")
                    sys.exit(2)
        elif a.startswith("-"):
            sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] [SCOPE] [-- <REPLACEMENT>]\n")
            sys.exit(2)
        else:
            positionals.append(a)
        i += 1

    if positionals:
        opts["scope"] = positionals[0]
        if len(positionals) > 1:
            sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '{positionals[1]}' found\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] [SCOPE] [-- <REPLACEMENT>]\n")
            sys.exit(2)

    has_standalone = opts["delete"] or opts["squeeze"]
    has_composable = (opts["upper"] or opts["lower"] or opts["titlecase"] or 
                      opts["normalize"] or opts["german"] or opts["symbols"] or 
                      opts["replacement"] is not None)

    if opts["delete"] and has_composable:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the argument '--delete' cannot be used with:\n  [REPLACEMENT]\n  --upper\n  --lower\n  --titlecase\n  --normalize\n  --german\n  --symbols\n\nUsage: executable --delete <SCOPE> [-- <REPLACEMENT>]\n")
        sys.exit(2)

    if has_standalone and opts["scope"] is None:
        action_name = "--delete" if opts["delete"] else "--squeeze"
        sys.stderr.write(f"error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <SCOPE>\n\nUsage: executable {action_name} <SCOPE> [-- <REPLACEMENT>]\n")
        sys.exit(2)

    if opts["literal_string"] and opts["scope"] is None:
        sys.stderr.write("error: The following required argument was not provided: scope\n\nUsage: srgn [OPTIONS] [SCOPE] [-- <REPLACEMENT>]\n")
        sys.exit(2)

    if opts["invert"] and not opts["symbols"]:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --symbols\n\nUsage: executable --symbols --invert [SCOPE] [-- <REPLACEMENT>]\n")
        sys.exit(2)

    if opts["scope"] is None:
        opts["scope"] = ".*"

    return opts

def process_content(text, opts, source_name="(stdin)"):
    scope_str = opts["scope"]
    if opts["literal_string"]:
        pattern_str = re.escape(scope_str)
    else:
        pattern_str = scope_str

    try:
        scope_re = re.compile(pattern_str)
    except re.error as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: Failed building regex\n\nCaused by:\n    Invalid regex: {e}\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    has_actions = (opts["upper"] or opts["lower"] or opts["titlecase"] or 
                   opts["normalize"] or opts["german"] or opts["symbols"] or 
                   opts["replacement"] is not None or opts["delete"] or opts["squeeze"])

    is_search_mode = not has_actions and len(opts["language_scopes"]) > 0

    if not has_actions and not is_search_mode and not opts["fail_any"] and not opts["fail_none"]:
        now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3] + "Z"
        sys.stderr.write(f"[{now} ERROR srgn] No actions specified, and not in search mode. Will return input unchanged, if any.\n")
        return text, False

    lang_spans = []
    if opts["language_scopes"]:
        for lang, val in opts["language_scopes"]:
            pattern_filter = None
            if "~" in val:
                val_base, pattern_filter = val.split("~", 1)
            else:
                val_base = val

            lang_dict = LANG_PATTERNS.get(lang, {})
            regex_str = lang_dict.get(val_base)
            if regex_str:
                l_re = re.compile(regex_str)
                for m in l_re.finditer(text):
                    m_start, m_end = m.span()
                    if m_start == m_end: continue
                    m_text = text[m_start:m_end]
                    if pattern_filter:
                        if not re.search(pattern_filter, m_text):
                            continue
                    lang_spans.append((m_start, m_end))

    def transform_span(span_text):
        if opts["delete"]:
            return ""
        if opts["squeeze"]:
            return span_text
            
        res = span_text
        if opts["replacement"] is not None:
            try:
                translated_repl = translate_replacement(opts["replacement"])
                res = scope_re.sub(translated_repl, res)
            except ValueError as ve:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: Failed building replacement string\n\nCaused by:\n    {ve}\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            except Exception as e:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: Error applying: Error in an action: Action failed in replacement: Error in variable expressions: Undefined variable, unable to substitute: {e}\n")
                sys.exit(1)

        if opts["symbols"]:
            res = apply_symbols(res, invert=opts["invert"])
        if opts["german"]:
            res = apply_german(res, naive=opts["german_naive"], prefer_original=opts["german_prefer_original"])
        if opts["normalize"]:
            res = apply_normalize(res)
        if opts["upper"]:
            res = res.replace("ß", "ẞ").upper()
        if opts["lower"]:
            res = res.lower()
        if opts["titlecase"]:
            res = apply_titlecase(res)
        return res

    # Squeeze action
    if opts["squeeze"]:
        matches = [m for m in scope_re.finditer(text) if m.span()[0] < m.span()[1]]
        if not matches:
            if opts["fail_none"]:
                sys.stderr.write("Error: Error applying: No input was in scope\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3] + "Z"
            sys.stderr.write(f"[{now} ERROR srgn] No actions specified, and not in search mode. Will return input unchanged, if any.\n")
            return text, False

        now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3] + "Z"
        sys.stderr.write(f"[{now} ERROR srgn] No actions specified, and not in search mode. Will return input unchanged, if any.\n")

        if opts["fail_any"]:
            sys.stderr.write("Error: Error applying: Some input was in scope\n")
            sys.exit(1)

        out_parts = []
        last_end = 0
        i = 0
        while i < len(matches):
            m = matches[i]
            m_start, m_end = m.span()
            out_parts.append(text[last_end:m_start])
            m_str = text[m_start:m_end]
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(matches) and matches[j].span()[0] == m_end and text[matches[j].span()[0]:matches[j].span()[1]] == m_str:
                m_end = matches[j].span()[1]
                j += 1
            out_parts.append(m_str)
            last_end = m_end
            i = j
        out_parts.append(text[last_end:])
        return "".join(out_parts), True

    all_matches = []
    if lang_spans:
        if opts["join_language_scopes"]:
            for l_start, l_end in lang_spans:
                sub_text = text[l_start:l_end]
                for m in scope_re.finditer(sub_text):
                    m_s, m_e = m.span()
                    if m_s < m_e:
                        all_matches.append((l_start + m_s, l_start + m_e, sub_text[m_s:m_e]))
        else:
            for l_start, l_end in lang_spans:
                sub_text = text[l_start:l_end]
                for m in scope_re.finditer(sub_text):
                    m_s, m_e = m.span()
                    if m_s < m_e:
                        all_matches.append((l_start + m_s, l_start + m_e, sub_text[m_s:m_e]))
    else:
        for m in scope_re.finditer(text):
            m_s, m_e = m.span()
            if m_s < m_e:
                all_matches.append((m_s, m_e, text[m_s:m_e]))

    if not all_matches:
        if opts["fail_none"]:
            sys.stderr.write("Error: Error applying: No input was in scope\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        if is_search_mode:
            return "", False

    if all_matches and opts["fail_any"]:
        sys.stderr.write("Error: Error applying: Some input was in scope\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    if is_search_mode:
        out_lines = []
        lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
        line_offsets = []
        curr = 0
        for l in lines:
            line_offsets.append(curr)
            curr += len(l)

        for m_s, m_e, _ in all_matches:
            l_idx = 0
            for idx, off in enumerate(line_offsets):
                if off <= m_s:
                    l_idx = idx
                else:
                    break
            line_num = l_idx + 1
            line_start_off = line_offsets[l_idx]
            col_start = m_s - line_start_off
            col_end = m_e - line_start_off
            line_str = lines[l_idx].rstrip("\r\n")
            out_lines.append(f"{source_name}:{line_num}:{col_start}-{col_end}:{line_str}")
        return "\n".join(out_lines) + ("\n" if out_lines else ""), True

    out_parts = []
    last_end = 0
    for m_s, m_e, m_str in all_matches:
        out_parts.append(text[last_end:m_s])
        transformed = transform_span(m_str)
        out_parts.append(transformed)
        last_end = m_e
    out_parts.append(text[last_end:])

    final_text = "".join(out_parts)

    if opts["only_matching"] or opts["line_numbers"]:
        lines = final_text.splitlines(keepends=True)
        line_offsets = []
        curr = 0
        for l in lines:
            line_offsets.append(curr)
            curr += len(l)

        out_lines = []
        for idx, (m_s, m_e, m_str) in enumerate(all_matches):
            l_idx = 0
            for l_i, off in enumerate(line_offsets):
                if off <= m_s:
                    l_idx = l_i
                else:
                    break
            line_num = l_idx + 1
            line_start_off = line_offsets[l_idx]
            col_start = m_s - line_start_off
            col_end = m_e - line_start_off
            line_content = lines[l_idx].rstrip("\r\n")

            if opts["only_matching"] and opts["line_numbers"]:
                out_lines.append(f"{source_name}:{line_num}:{col_start}-{col_end}:{transform_span(m_str)}")
            elif opts["only_matching"]:
                out_lines.append(f"{source_name}:{col_start}-{col_end}:{transform_span(m_str)}")
            elif opts["line_numbers"]:
                out_lines.append(f"{source_name}:{line_num}:{col_start}-{col_end}:{line_content}")

        return "\n".join(out_lines) + ("\n" if out_lines else ""), True

    return final_text, True

def main():
    opts = parse_args()

    if opts["glob"] is not None:
        glob_pattern = opts["glob"]
        matched_files = glob.glob(glob_pattern, recursive=True)
        if not matched_files:
            if opts["fail_no_files"]:
                sys.stderr.write("Error: No files found\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            sys.exit(0)

        if opts["sorted"]:
            matched_files.sort()

        for filepath in matched_files:
            if os.path.isfile(filepath):
                try:
                    with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                        content = f.read()
                except Exception:
                    continue

                res_text, modified = process_content(content, opts, source_name=filepath)
                if modified and res_text != content:
                    if opts["dry_run"]:
                        sys.stdout.write(res_text)
                    else:
                        try:
                            with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                                f.write(res_text)
                            print(filepath)
                        except Exception:
                            pass
        sys.exit(0)

    is_stdin = True
    if opts["stdin_detection"] == "force-unreadable":
        is_stdin = False
    elif opts["stdin_detection"] == "auto":
        is_stdin = not sys.stdin.isatty()

    if is_stdin:
        try:
            content = sys.stdin.read()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            sys.exit(130)
        res_text, _ = process_content(content, opts, source_name="(stdin)")
        sys.stdout.write(res_text)
        sys.exit(0)

    target_exts = set()
    for lang, _ in opts["language_scopes"]:
        target_exts.update(LANG_EXTENSIONS.get(lang, []))

    files_to_process = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
